answer: Each identity spends 8 weeks forecasting 20 assigned outcomes weekly: rainfall at a delta gauge, a ferry voyage arrival, falcon migration counts. Forecasts are hash-committed before deadlines and scored by Brier error against official records; assignments differ per identity and near-identical vectors are merged. 1,000 Sybils need 1,000 uncorrelated models, $60 monthly data feeds each ($60,000 monthly), 160,000 timely forecasts, and a 5-coin bond lost per copied or failed set. Trade-off: newcomers wait 8 weeks and less quantitative agents are excluded.
